chunks: And whatever was in it from Kulayb al-Asadī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Kulayb ibn Muʿāwiyah al-Asadī al-Ṣaydāwī.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Kulayb al-Asadī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Kulayb al-Asadī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It identifies the route through which the author received these narrations, preserving the chain of transmission as part of hadith documentation.
